sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: - The TKPD Sniper and TKPD Assault are quasi-fictitious custom weapons based on the real-life SVDK (GRAU index - 6V9) precision rifle. Originally conceptualized for the early 2010s cancelled Russia 2028 game prototype, the weapons were later repurposed for Escape From Tarkov's predecessors and prequels, Contract Wars and Hired Ops, appearing in every game in the series thus far.
